ordering_basis: Information value, access and implementability; not predicted returns or investment allocation.

tracks.mechanism_to_test: Continuation after a scheduled macro release, conditional on contemporaneous liquidity and direction.
tracks.first_data_gate: Exact contract-month trades and executable quotes, receive timestamps, roll/settlement calendar, current IBKR permissions, minimum-equity rules, initial/maintenance margin and all-in fees.
tracks.rejection_before_performance: A minimum integer contract cannot fit risk/funding constraints, or quotes/depth cannot support delayed entry and exit.
tracks.history_rule: No NES/NNQ synthetic fills before listing. ES/MES can support signal discovery only; cannot certify nano execution. Short post-launch histories cannot establish one-year returns.
tracks.access_probe: Actual September 2026 NESZ6/MESZ6 and NESU6/MESU6 five-minute aggregates retrieved. Calendar-roll coverage: NES 1600/1638, MES 1614/1638. Shared two-hour September 11 gap unresolved. Earlier quote access was NOT_ENTITLED; no account margin/permission or fill verification.

tracks.mechanism_to_test: Post-announcement price continuation after information is public; compare stock and ETF expressions.
tracks.first_data_gate: Point-in-time event release/receipt times, delisted-inclusive universe, corporate actions, minute quotes, account-specific costs and buying power.
tracks.rejection_before_performance: The apparent edge requires retrospective event labels, future constituent selection or fills before receipt.

subtests.scope: Opening-session price continuation on SPY/QQQ/TQQQ. This does not test earnings or scheduled announcement continuation.
subtests.data: Massive actual unadjusted 5-minute ETF aggregates, 2025 and 2026 Q1-Q3. Quotes and earnings endpoints returned NOT_ENTITLED.
subtests.next_requirement: An independently motivated new event hypothesis needs point-in-time event times and executable quotes; retain this failure and count subsequent revisions.

subtests.scope: 14 scheduled FOMC decisions on previously inspected M2 ETF data, positive-reaction long-only rule. One shared trading event in 2025 and zero in 2026; annual inactivity charged. Not independent holdout validation.
subtests.next_requirement: Any two-sided or negative-response variant is a new trial requiring its own frozen design, tradable instrument/cost model and unused evaluation data.

tracks.mechanism_to_test: A separately validated signal may benefit from a convex payoff; test against the same signal in the underlying after premium, IV changes and execution costs.
tracks.first_data_gate: Actual OPRA or exchange option quotes and sizes, expired chains, per-contract multiplier/deliverable, account option level and exercise/assignment funding.
tracks.rejection_before_performance: Indicative quotes presented as executable, stale spreads, one contract above risk budget, unmodeled assignment or insufficient close-out depth.
tracks.liquidity_note: Cboe public NANOS page showed volume 104 and open interest 1296 as of 2026-10-09. One day is not an ADV estimate or a fill test. Keep on watchlist until quotes establish feasibility.

tracks.mechanism_to_test: Reversal after directly observed temporary sell-pressure decay.
tracks.first_data_gate: Trade/order-book and receipt timestamps, verified market access and funding/liquidation model for derivatives.
tracks.rejection_before_performance: Pressure is inferred from future lows, or fees, funding, adverse selection and missed fills erase the effect.
tracks.legacy_result: The rejected H1 breakout baseline remains rejected; it is not relabeled as H2.

additional_scope: FX, rates, commodity futures, bonds and other products remain admissible after the same access/size/cost/data gates.
No remote broker API, order router or unattended research schedule has been enabled.

next_candidate.motivation: Descriptive directional continuation differences are positive over 14 shared events; no costs or executable short positions in that statistic.
next_candidate.hypothesis_to_formalize: Negative-response or two-sided post-FOMC continuation after executable delay and full costs.
required_gates: Freeze a new rule before evaluation and retain all prior trials.
Resolve shared futures data gap without deleting it or filling it with invented prices.
Actual inverse-ETF or dated-futures prices, executable quotes and account-specific funding/fees.
Untouched chronological and future paper data; previously used 2025/2026 histories remain development data.
